_exec_summary.SummaryText:
The Pittsburgh Paints Company Riverside, Ca location is a 250,800 square foot facility, that specializes in shipping, handling and storage of paints and commonly used consumable painting supplies. This facility currently handles and stores Aerosol paint, which constituents are the substances of consideration regarding RMP applicability. The site currently follows Applicable State, US EPA, Department of Transportation, NFPA, and OSHA requirements for the storage, handling and shipping of regulated items. Pittsburgh Paints Company also follows internal and local Emergency response policies and regularly works with regulating agencies and neighbors to foster a positive culture and community right to know. 
Regulated Substances/ Chemicals of Interest/ Process Chemicals
Chemical Name	CAS No. 	Threshold Quantity
Propane	74-98-6	10,000 lbs
Butane	106-97-8	10,000 lbs
Isobutane	75-28-5	10,000 lbs
Methyl Ether	115-10-6	10,000 lbs
   The PPC Riverside Distribution Center stores paint in aerosol containers, of various sizes with a median average of one pound each container, for distribution to PPC owned stores, dealers and home centers throughout the United States.  These containers can contain one of the following: Propane, Methyl Ether, Isobutane and or Butane, which are used as propellants.  These materials are regulated as flammable substances under the EPA RMP regulations.
Safety Systems
   The site currently has various safe working systems in place. This includes 
	NFPA compliant storage cages to contain incidents 
	Facility wide sprinkler systems
	In rack sprinkler systems within the designated storage cage
	Electric non sparking motorized equipment 
	Employee orientation and ongoing training
	Material handing work instructions
	Incident response measures
	Spill reporting procedures
Employee Training
